outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: (1) The agent’s location match to Redmond, WA is not explicitly proven from on-page location text in the provided evidence; however, the search context clearly uses Redmond, Washington and the listing is clearly an Applied Scientist role, so this is at most a minor ambiguity, not the main failure. (2) Minor paraphrase of work-site arrangement (“hybrid 3-days/week in-office”) vs the page text (“Work site 3 days / week in-office”) is acceptable.

Critical issues: The agent did not provide two key responsibilities and did not provide two preferred qualifications. Those are explicitly required outputs and are the primary deliverable of the task after opening a listing. The agent instead reported it could not access the detailed text due to missing DOM/bullet content. There’s no evidence the agent successfully extracted those sections, and the final output contains none of the requested responsibility/qualification items. While the agent did successfully (and evidentially) extract the job number (200017828) and work-site arrangement (3 days/week in-office) from the listing, that is insufficient to satisfy the user’s request.

Outcome assessment: The agent complied with constraints (no sign-in, no apply, no form submission) and did open a relevant Applied Scientist listing. However, it failed to deliver the required extracted responsibilities and preferred qualifications, so from an average user perspective the task is not completed.
outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted the agent to use Microsoft Careers to find an Applied Scientist job listing in/for Redmond, WA, open one relevant listing, and then report specific facts from that listing: job number, work-site arrangement, two key responsibilities, and two preferred qualifications—without signing in, applying, or submitting forms. A reasonable user would be flexible on which specific Applied Scientist listing is chosen (as long as it’s relevant and reasonably tied to Redmond/nearby), but not flexible on missing the requested extracted details, especially responsibilities and preferred qualifications (the core deliverable).
